limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Legacy live source links remain unnormalized in references/legacy-source-notes.md; only the declared immutable source slices are normalized.
Added Ascend case is limited to normal native single-tier CPU descriptor-pool ownership; vLLM compatibility and CANN retention/teardown contracts remain unqualified.
PyTorch source-derived CUDA transfer/host allocator candidate; hardware, graph implementation, custom allocators, NUMA and service efficacy are not qualified.
CPython v3.13.0 documentation corrects GIL detection only; no free-threaded interpreter or inference-stack compatibility test was run.

applicability.scope: Audit host preparation, pinned-host pressure and asynchronous CUDA-copy ownership/order/lifetime, with separately scoped routing for Ascend descriptor retention, Python preprocessing and NUMA placement.
applicability.input_contract: Host buffer ownership and alias/mutation behavior, copy direction/dtype/layout, producer/consumer streams, live/in-flight/cache budget and the actual interpreter/placement context.
applicability.produced_artifact: An ownership and dependency audit with bounded transfer candidates and a correctness-first validation plan separating enqueue, pinning, transfer, model and end-to-end cost.
applicability.failure_modes: A stream wait does not prevent CPU mutation and record_stream does not create a data dependency; cached host storage may outlive Python scope, and the eager reusable-slot example is not capture-safe.

recommendations: Track copy-before-consumer order, CPU payload reuse and device storage lifetime as three independent obligations; wait for D2H completion before CPU reads.
Compare pageable, per-request pinning and bounded reuse on the real workload while budgeting all live and in-flight slots, cache and preprocessing memory.
Keep the eager staging-slot preconditions explicit and validate ordering/lifetime under stress before performance; a small passing sample does not establish a hazardous pattern is safe.
